description: Reverse engineering: construction drawing of 12m beam with point load
message: Build a calculation model from the attached drawing and engineering specification, then run static analysis. Ask for clarification instead of guessing any image information that cannot be identified reliably.
engineeringSpecification: Material steel: E=205000 MPa, nu=0.3, density=7850 kg/m3. All members use section B1 (A=0.01 m2, Iy=0.0001 m4, Iz=0.0001 m4, J=0.0001 m4, G=79000 MPa). Use SI units and the global-z-up coordinate convention. Use only the load cases and load magnitudes annotated in the drawing; do not add member self-weight. Analyze load combination ULS = 1 x LC1. In addition to the point-load node, discretize the beam at midspan with a connected analysis node and report the midspan vertical deflection.
